title.rendered: Announcements from Bushiroad English Conference Autumn 2026

content.rendered:
Here is a recap on the announcements made during the Bushiroad English Conference Autumn 2026, which aired on November 6, 2026!

 

 

Palworld OFFICIAL CARD GAME Trial Deck Eternal Ascent

Overwhelm your opponents with undeniable power in Trial Deck "Eternal Ascent Red・Green" and corner your opponents with tactical maneuvers in Trial Deck "Eternal Ascent Blue・Purple"!

Introducing the new 'Rank Up' ability in these two trial decks, where you can deploy a Pal with the same name on top of the other!

On top of that, 2 random souls out of 10 total types featuring illustrations from the first Booster Pack, Dawn of Palpagos will be added to the 10-card soul deck!

Eternal Ascent "Red・Green" and "Blue・Purple" descend into stores on December 18!

Click on the links below to find more on the Trial Decks!

 

 

Trial Deck "Red・Green" Trial Deck "Blue・Purple"

 

 

 

 

Palworld OFFICIAL CARD GAME Booster Pack Eternal Ascent

Additionally, releasing on January 30, 2027, the Palworld OFFICIAL CARD GAME Booster Pack Eternal Ascent will feature even more 'Rank Up' abilities. Consisting of 100 types of cards, 7 cards per pack and, 12 packs per box.

Click on the link below to find more on the Booster Pack!

 

 

Booster Pack Eternal Ascent

 

 

 

 

Legends Awaken Release Tournament

We're excited to announce that the Release Tournament for the Palworld OFFICIAL CARD GAME, Legends Awaken, is taking place this November!

All participants will receive 1 ESOUL-017 Promo Card and will also receive 1 exclusive Bushi Navi flair.

The champion will also receive a playmat featuring illustrations of Frostallion, Jetragon & Frostallion Noct, and, will also receive 1 exclusive Bushi Navi flair!

Click on the link below to find out more on the Release Tournament!

 

Legends Awaken Release Tournament

 

 

Palworld OFFICIAL CARD GAME Official Support App

Experience battles anew with our new official support app for the Palworld OFFICIAL CARD GAME!

Enhance your battle experience with various quality of life functions like keeping track of your life points, materials, and ingredients!

The new Palworld Support App will be available for download soon so keep your eyes peeled for more information!

 

 

Masters League 26/27

Masters League 26/27 kicks off this month!
 
Take part in the ultimate battle to crown the first-ever Palworld OFFICIAL CARD GAME world champion and win awesome prizes such as promos, playmats, and more! Check out the Champion Trophy, will you be the one to hoist the trophy?

Be sure to check our official website for the latest event schedule, participating locations, and more details! Mark your calendars and be sure to join us before it's too late!

 

Click to find out more on Masters League 26/27!

 

 

More Upcoming Events

Players around the world can look forward to a packed lineup of exciting events - including Shop Tournaments, Christmas Snowdown, Challengers Cup Season 2, and side events!

Whether you're competing for attractive promo cards and prizes, testing your skills against fellow participants, or simply enjoying the game with friends, there's an event for everyone.

Be sure to check our official website for the latest event schedule, participating locations, and more details!

 

Click to find out more!
